name: com.unity.usd-toolkit
description: Runtime USD toolkit for Unity applications using a custom native OpenUSD wrapper. A C# integration layer for connecting Unity to NVIDIA's Omniverse/OpenUSD ecosystem. Wraps Pixar's OpenUSD 26.05 native binaries via P/Invoke so Unity can read, write, and round-trip USD stages.

samples.description: Two runtime scenes sharing one UI theme. Export Example exports the open scene to USD, and Import Example scans a folder for USD files and imports them.

A URP render setup (Deferred, Surface Cache GI, screen-space reflections, Isaac Sim's tone curve as a LUT) that brings an imported stage close to Isaac Sim 6.2's RTX Real-Time renderer, with a menu that imports a USD file into the sample scene and saves the result.
Streams transforms in both directions between a running Unity scene and Isaac Sim 6.1.0 or a Python client over loopback TCP.

A PLM-style runtime demo: import several USD files through a native file dialog, select and move parts with a transform gizmo, correct Z-up and centimetre stages, and export the result as a referencing layer or a flattened stage. Requires URP, the Input System and uGUI.
An AGV fleet in a factory hall that runs locally in Unity or is simulated by Isaac Sim 6.1.0 over a shared USD stage. Requires URP and the Input System.

Imports an Isaac Sim robot with its UsdPhysics (ArticulationBody joints, limits, drives, colliders) and compares every joint and body with what Isaac Sim shows; drives the joints and runs a limit test in Play Mode. Ships a small arm and downloads NVIDIA's Franka Panda (Isaac Sim 6.0) on request.
